items.title: Have alternatives to your preferred option
items.quote: ✅ Have alternatives to your preferred option If you have alternatives, you can approach a negotiation with a completely different level of confidence. When you only have one option, your leverage decreases, and so does your ability to negotiate effectively.

items.title: Be ready to walk away
items.quote: ✅ Be ready to walk away You must be willing to walk away from a negotiation. Only then will you have the strength to convince the other side and hold your ground.

items.title: Don’t be the final decision-maker
items.quote: ✅ Don’t be the final decision-maker Whether or not you are the final decision-maker, involve someone else in the process - your partner, CEO, manager, or even the bank. By doing this, you position yourself as a mediator rather than the person confronting the other side directly.

items.title: See negotiations as a game
items.quote: ✅ See negotiations as a game Negotiations are a dance, a game. Sometimes you win, and sometimes you lose, but the key is to enjoy playing. This mindset will help you approach negotiations with less pressure and more confidence.

items.title: Remember you always have power
items.quote: ✅ Remember you always have power No matter what someone says, they need you just as much as you need them. Whether their organization is big or small, there is mutual dependency. Recognizing your own power in a negotiation can change how you approach it.

items.title: 1. AI tools for script writing.
items.quote: 1. AI tools for script writing. Don’t settle for a generic ChatGPT model. Train your own ChatGPT to mimic your style and write the way you speak. You can do this with tools like ChatGPT or Jasper.

items.title: 2. Use collaboration tools on stage.
items.quote: 2. Use collaboration tools on stage. Engaging the audience in real time is not only effective – it’s fun. Tools like Miro and Slido are absolutely fantastic for this.

items.title: 3. Manage stage fright and overall well-being.
items.quote: 3. Manage stage fright and overall well-being. With tech, you can improve your physical state – whether through meditation, body temperature regulation, or overall well-being. Ambr Wave, Fitbit, and Calm are terrific tools to help with this.

items.title: 4. Get creative with AI.
items.quote: 4. Get creative with AI. Use AI for video, image, and music creation. Tools like Synthesia, Canva, and AIVA allow you to generate amazing content to elevate your presentations.

items.title: 5. Practice with VR training tools.
items.quote: 5. Practice with VR training tools. Immersive practice is a game-changer. VR tools let you stand in a closet or cabinet and feel like you’re presenting to a full auditorium. VirtualSpeech, Ovation, and SpeechTrainers are fun and effective ways to sharpen your skills. Have you ever tried any of these tools? #FloAkinbiyi #PublicSpeaking #PresentationSkills #AIforPresenters #AI #Innovation #CommunicationTools #LeadershipSkills #ProfessionalDevelopment
